item.text: I’ll inspect the session persistence code and its existing tests, write the required checkpoint early, then implement the null-based behavior and run the relevant existing tests.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: Fix persisted public-session lookup so "'`getLastPersistedLocalID` is synchronous and returns `number | null`, ignores unrelated storage keys, treats malformed values safely, and performs read-only localStorage access.

Progress: Repository inspection started. Next: locate implementation and existing tests, make the smallest compatible change, and run relevant existing tests.
EOF

item.text: The helper currently relies on “last active” pings for account selection, but the persisted-session key itself must be numeric before it can produce an ID. I’ve added that validation and changed empty/error results to `null`; I’m now updating the caller’s handling and the existing assertions to match the nullable return type.
